Backs up by itself a couple of minutes after you finish writing: one file per notebook in a “Tali\'s Notes” folder in your Drive, sending only the notebooks that changed. The app can only see its own files, nothing else in your Drive.

Upright A4 pages one under the other, like a real notebook. Exports page by page.

Your notebooks are saved. Sending the report helps fix what went wrong.
A4 pages that keep coming as you write. Pinch to zoom, slide with two fingers, and everything saves the moment you write it.
Tap a pen to write with it, and tap it again for its settings: type, thickness, line style and colours. Your favourite colours and three thicknesses sit right in the toolbar.
Draw a line, a circle or a box and keep the pen still at the end: it snaps into a clean shape. Keep moving to size it. A wavy stroke becomes a smooth curve.

The Shapes tool has the basics, and shapes for every subject: engineering, law, health, economics and more. Star yours to keep them close. Their dots change what they are: pull a stack longer and it gets more cells.
Circle anything with the lasso to move, resize, recolour, lock or copy it. Once something is copied, hold the pen anywhere to paste it.
Record a voice memo right beside your notes with the mic. Open a PDF from any app to look through it, or save it and write on the slides.
Hold the S Pen\'s button to erase with any tool. Star your favourite pens, then double-press the button to jump between them. Tap with two fingers to undo.
Everything is saved on the tablet as you write. Turn on Google Drive or Back up by itself in Backups, at the bottom left, and your notes are safe even if the tablet isn\'t.
